items.headline: $X100 Exploit Drains $4.85M After Governance Takeover
items.summary: Attackers seized $X100 governance and converted treasury tokens and LP positions into 4.85M USDT, with Blockaid warning the Ethereum exploit was still ongoing.

items.headline: $X100 Hit Again: 550K X Pulled From Uniswap Pool
items.summary: A third $X100 exploit transaction routed ~549,916 X to a new wallet, draining a Uniswap pool that held under 200 USDT in remaining liquidity.

items.headline: $HYPE vs CME: Clash Over Who Bears US Compliance
items.summary: Hyperliquid's Yan and CME's Duffy split over compliance burdens, with Yan arguing market deployers — not the chain — should face oversight as $HYPE's interface still blocks US users.

items.headline: $REFLECT Launches Create for Yield Stablecoins on Solana
items.summary: Reflect Money unveiled Create, a new tool for launching yield-bearing stablecoins on Solana, opening a fresh DeFi design space for $REFLECT's ecosystem.

items.headline: $UNI Slides 29% in a Month Despite $4B Liquidity
items.summary: $UNI has underperformed BTC and ETH over four weeks even as Uniswap's liquidity holds near $4B — a divergence traders are watching for a rebound setup.
